reasoning_content:
The oneshot ran successfully and cleaned up the temporary unit files, leaving only the daemon service. I'm checking the process list and noticing the runuser wrapper is showing as a root process, but I need to verify the perl daemon itself is still running since my grep filter might have been incomplete.

Now I'm moving to comprehensive verification: checking the database has the expected tables, confirming the admin user exists with a valid password hash, reviewing the QisutuConfig.pm file for correct settings, testing the web interface at the login page, verifying the daemon process is alive, checking the install log, and most importantly, attempting an actual login with the admin credentials to prove the installation works end-to-end.

action.command: echo "=== processes ==="; ps aux | grep -E "qisutu-daemon|apache2|maria" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1, $2, $11, $12, $13}'; echo; echo "=== DB: tables ==="; mariadb -uqisutu -p"$(grep db_password /opt/qisutu/core/config/QisutuConfig.pm | head -1 | sed "s/.*'\\(.*\\)'.*/\\1/")" qisutu -e "SHOW TABLES" 2>/dev/null | wc -l; grep -o "db_password[^;]*" /opt/qisutu/core/config/QisutuConfig.pm | head -2

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "echo \"=== processes ===\"; ps aux | grep -E \"qisutu-daemon|apache2|maria\" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1, $2, $11, $12, $13}'; echo; echo \"=== DB: tables ===\"; mariadb -uqisutu -p\"$(grep db_password /opt/qisutu/core/config/QisutuConfig.pm | head -1 | sed \"s/.*'\\\\(.*\\\\)'.*/\\\\1/\")\" qisutu -e \"SHOW TABLES\" 2>/dev/null | wc -l; grep -o \"db_password[^;]*\" /opt/qisutu/core/config/QisutuConfig.pm | head -2", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Verify processes and database tables"}
